title: Remove folder while its project is loaded leaves Inspector dangling

Per spec § Acceptance: 'the currently-selected project (if it came from that folder) clears back to the empty state.' Fix: in library-store.removeFolder, if useProjectStore.current.path is one of the removed folder's projects, call useProjectStore.clear().
